verdict.rationale: Azure's Terraform documentation lists an 'Export resources to HCL code' workflow, which is a first-party path for bringing existing resources under IaC rather than only greenfield deployment. The evidence is a single heading-level mention. Bicep and ARM template evidence covers only declarative deployment, not import or drift. Missing for 10: documented drift detection/reconciliation workflow, Bicep/ARM export or import of existing resources, depth on the HCL export process and its limitations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, existing resources can come under IaC — documented import/drift workflows instead of a greenfield-only story
